end.summary:
Discussed storing drinking water in clean, covered containers.
Practised using a ladle or tap instead of hands and cleaning containers regularly.
Pari explained that covers help keep out dust, germs, leaves and mosquitoes.
Practised saving water by turning off the tap while brushing and using limited water for rinsing.
Teach-back was not passed; storage-safety responses were unaided and correct on both attempts.
end.parentNote: Pari practised safe water storage using clean, covered containers, a ladle or tap, and regular cleaning. They explained the method by identifying dust, germs and mosquitoes as reasons to cover water, and they also described turning off the tap while brushing. There was no recorded misconception; the full teach-back was not completed successfully. At home, ask Pari to show how they would cover drinking water and use a ladle without touching the water.
